note: Where the roadside props stand. Coordinates are the straight track's: lap = metres along the lap (the prop goes to the nearest copy of its site), u = metres into the 11.9 m tile, edge = how far the prop's inner edge is from the middle of the road (negative = left), lat = its centre (gate), ground = metres above the road, turn = degrees the prop's front is turned from facing the road towards the oncoming rider. Slots: 1 tower, 2 building, 3 monument, 4 finish gate, 5-7 medium, 8 finish flag, 9-10 small. The passage is a root tunnel about 5 m wide: its walls are solid, so a prop set back from the road is hidden or ghosted behind roots. The sites are the gaps between the tall standing stones, measured over all five worlds (splats 0.8-1.6 m above the road, 1.9-3.4 m from the middle): left 0.4-4.0 m into the tile (L) and 6.6-7.6 (l2); right 4.4-7.2 (R), 8.7-10.0 (r2) and 1.1-2.6 (r3). A prop stands in the row itself; a site's along / across are the most room it may take. Inner edges are just outside what the bars can reach at that site (lane limit there + 0.42 m bar + 0.1 m): 1.65 m at the narrow sites l2 and r3, 1.95 to 2.0 m at the others. Large props are scaled to fit (height_scale, max_along_m, max_across_m): their backs run into the roots. Finish gates: the road is funnelled to gate.lane_cap_m from the middle near a gate (bars then reach 1.22 m), and the gate's opening is gate.opening_half_m.

rocks.note: Low rocks on the road (slot 11, from runs/five-map-bump-rocks-2026-11-15; 60 x 45 x 15 cm as made, drawn twice that, 1.2 x 0.9 x 0.3 m, because the bike hides the road nearer than about 12 m and the rock has to be seen from further off; the trigger radii are scaled with it). Placements with a lat and no site: lat = metres from the middle of the road. One side of the road is always left clear. Five round the lap (the user's number), none near the start line and finish gate. A rock that would fall on the seam between tile copies this lap is moved on by seam_shift_m. tint darkens a world's rock (1 = as made): the day rock is the colour of the path.

moving.note: Parts that turn, cut out of a model at load (fantasy-props.js splitMoving). Keys are world/slot; numbers are in the model's own units (it is about 1.9 units tall, y up, front +z).

spin.what: waterwheel (centre and radius 0.675 fitted to its rim)

flags.note: Finish flags (slot 8) wave: amp_frac of the cloth's length front and back at its free end, `waves` wavelengths along it, speed in radians a second.
